Overview.Name: Venkatesh Jujjuri
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (100 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (100 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (moderate portion) + paneer cubes (80 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~180 g) + paneer curry (150 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (100 g) + 2 Roti + Bowl of Curd
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (moderate portion) + paneer cubes (80 g) + Bowl of Curd

Notes_and_Tips: With 1 meals per day, ensure each meal has strong protein like paneer or curd.
Do not eat only fruits or salads. Always include paneer or curd.
Keep rice moderate and make protein the main portion.
Have a protein shake whenever you can
Low daily steps mean portion control is important.
Consistent protein intake will improve energy and maintain lean body composition.
